EventName.description_en:
The name of the issue. Valid values:

NoSnapshot: data protection.
BurstIOTriggered: burst I/O.
CostOptimizationNeeded: cost optimization.
DiskSpecNotMatchedWithInstance: mismatch between instance and cloud disk specifications.
DiskIONo4kAligned: non-4K aligned read and write operations.
DiskIOHang: cloud disk I/O hang.
InstanceIOPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit: instance IOPS reaches the upper limit.
InstanceBPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit: instance BPS reaches the upper limit.
DiskIOPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit: cloud disk IOPS reaches the instance upper limit.
DiskBPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit: cloud disk BPS reaches the instance upper limit.
DiskIOPSExceedDiskMaxLimit: cloud disk IOPS reaches the cloud disk upper limit.
DiskBPSExceedDiskMaxLimit: cloud disk BPS reaches the cloud disk upper limit
EventName.description_zh:
问题名称。可能值：

NoSnapshot：数据保护
BurstIOTriggered：突发 IO
CostOptimizationNeeded：成本优化
DiskSpecNotMatchedWithInstance：实例与磁盘规格不匹配
DiskIONo4kAligned：非 4K 对齐读写
DiskIOHang：磁盘有 IOHang 发生
InstanceIOPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit：实例 IOPS 到达上限
InstanceBPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit：实例 BPS 到达上限
DiskIOPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit：磁盘 IOPS 到达实例上限
DiskBPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit：磁盘 BPS 到达实例上限
DiskIOPSExceedDiskMaxLimit：磁盘 IOPS 到达磁盘上限
DiskBPSExceedDiskMaxLimit：磁盘 BPS 到达磁盘上限

RecommendAction.description_en:
The recommended action after the event occurs. Valid values:

ModifyDiskSpec: changes the specifications.
CreateSnapshot: creates a snapshot.
ResizeDisk: resizes the cloud disk.
AdjustProvision: adjusts the provisioned performance.
ModifyInstanceSpec: changes the instance specifications
RecommendAction.description_zh:
事件发生后的推荐操作。可能值：

ModifyDiskSpec：变配
CreateSnapshot：打快照
ResizeDisk：扩容
AdjustProvision：调节预配置等
ModifyInstanceSpec：实例变配

RecommendParams.description_en: The parameters for the recommended action after the event occurs
RecommendParams.description_zh: 事件发生后的推荐操作的参数

Severity.description_en:
The severity level of the diagnosed issue. The severity levels in ascending order are:

Info: associated information that may be related to an exception.
Warn: associated information that may cause an exception.
Critical: a critical exception
Severity.description_zh:
诊断问题严重程度，严重等级由轻到重如下：

Info：有关联信息，可能与异常相关。
Warn：有关联信息，可能导致异常。
Critical：有关键异常

StartTime.description_zh: 事件开始时间戳（毫秒级）
